chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 449 – Daring the Immortals: Ji Ning’s Battle of Face
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning goads five Celestial Immortals into a trap, using 71 formation layers and the ruins of their own clan city as his battlefield. The tension is knife-edge.
og_title: Ji Ning vs. Five Immortals: The Ultimate Provocation
og_description: The sword immortal laughs in the face of five ancient powers, turning their base into his own killing ground. The countdown to battle begins.
twitter_title: Ji Ning is about to bag five Immortals at once 👀
twitter_description: Our favorite Fiendgod swordsman has declared war on the entire Shaoyin clan’s immortal council. It’s a trap, and the bait is himself!

lore_anchors.definition: A cultivator who has survived the Heavenly Tribulation and achieved immortality; they are among the highest powers in the mortal realms.
A Chinese cultural concept of social reputation and dignity; losing face in public can be worse than losing a battle.
A million-year-old cultivator whose true body was just killed by Ji Ning; his second body survives to witness the coming storm.
